lignes: Hello! I am Sara. I am sixteen years old. I am from Oran.
Nice to meet you. How are you? I am fine, thank you.
Good morning, teacher! Good evening, class!
This is my friend Karim. He is a student. He is from Tlemcen.
We are in the same class. I am a student too.
What is your name? My name is Lina.
I have a big family. My father is a farmer. My mother is a nurse.
I have three brothers and two sisters. We live with my grandparents.
This is my brother. He is tall.
My uncle is an engineer. My aunt is a doctor.
My cousin is young. He is five years old.
I love my family and they love me.
I wake up at six. I have breakfast at seven. I go to school at eight.
I have lunch at noon. I sleep at ten.
In the morning I study. In the afternoon I play football.
My day is busy. In the evening I do my homework and read a little.
I always help my mother. I never sleep late.
She often watches TV after dinner.
My school is big. There are twenty classrooms.
There is a library and a playground. My favourite subject is English.
The teacher is kind and helpful.
In my bag there are books, pens and a copybook.
On the desk there is a computer. Under the chair there is a ball.
The board is clean and the windows are open.
I like fruit and vegetables. I eat an apple every day.
I drink milk and water. I do not like fast food.
Would you like some tea? Yes, please.
There is some bread and cheese on the table.
There are some tomatoes in the fridge.
How many apples are there? There are three.
I have a headache. You should see a doctor.
You shouldn't eat too much sugar. Wash your hands before meals.
My brother has a cold. He should rest and drink hot water.
The body has two arms, two legs and a head.
I brush my teeth twice a day. I sleep eight hours.
A healthy body needs water, food and sport.
In my free time I like reading and swimming. I can play chess.
My sister enjoys drawing. We often go hiking.
What do you like doing at the weekend?
I love watching films. I don't like cooking.
My friends enjoy playing video games. She hates waiting.
Can you ride a bike? Yes, I can.
My city is beautiful. The streets are clean. The people are friendly.
It is bigger than my village. It is the most beautiful in the region.
The old castle is famous.
She is tall and slim. He is wearing a blue jacket.
The house is old but charming. The garden is full of flowers.
He is older than me but younger than my father.
